size.$description: Text sizes at the default text-size setting, px at the 1920x1080 reference. Since ui-2.0.0 the numbers and the loud titles follow the target page (pages/suit-final) x 1.5: display 36 (the timer, 24 px there), display-large 78 (the dead's countdown, 52 px), hero 126 (the ends' titles, 84 px), kicker 14 (the tiles' Unbounded capitals, at least 14 to stay readable).

theme-default.$description: Godot's Theme.default_font_size: the size of text whose type sets none of its own (a bare Label, a ProgressBar's percentage). 27, the greybox's 16 x 5/3, kept so bare text does not change (prime-game-ui#52).

keycap.$description: A keycap's minimum width: its height (the 5 px top margin + the 29 px line of 22 px Onest + the 8 px bottom margin), so a single-letter keycap is square.
